scope: Current OuchiMaintenance and local OuchiCore native sources, package/project dependencies, and iPhoneOS Release binary load commands; Web/server dependencies are not linked into the native app.
classification: Encryption provided within the Apple operating system
meaning: Exempt from uploading encryption documentation in App Store Connect; does not mean no encryption, Apple approval, or exemption from all export obligations.

implementations.use: Authenticated local encryption for pending registration and purchase recovery records
Integrity, scoped challenge hashes, backup checksum and transaction consistency
OS Keychain, secure random keys and OS App Attest operations

dependencies: Local OuchiCore only; no external Swift package, binary target, external framework or custom cryptographic primitive identified. Release load commands resolve only to Apple OS frameworks and system Swift/runtime libraries.
guard: verify-store-artifact.py checks the built boolean and all packaged Mach-O dependencies. Unexpected bundled/static libraries or non-system load commands require renewed review; this guard cannot detect custom or statically compiled algorithms by itself.
recheckBeforeUpload: Inspect the final signed artifact using verify-store-artifact.py, not just source Info.plist.
Re-review cryptographic source and dependency changes, including local packages, static code, build scripts and any new platform or territory.
Do not infer App Store acceptance or the completion of other export obligations from this technical classification.
